svg.title: Retail analysis assistant — production architecture
svg.desc: The web client passes chat, settings and feedback through a separate Google IAP service. One Identity and access box represents public-key caching and refresh, per-request JWT validation, loading the user row and checking chat ownership; the technical explanation details these internal steps. Authenticated requests pass identity and access checks before context assembly loads shared system lessons before private user memory, settings and permitted history. Fixed access, safety, schema and metric rules stay above learned context. LangGraph routes intent before its retrieve_examples node calls the Context retrieval module with the focused question and trusted user and brand scope. The module combines keyword and vector search over knowledge.examples, applies brand filters and ranks approved Golden examples. It returns up to three permitted question, SQL and explanation examples with provenance. SQL always uses the query validation node. The query node enforces current brand scope, approved fields, SQL validation and execution limits. BigQuery returns scoped results and job statistics directly to the LangGraph agent. After finish_plan, two independent reflection calls run in parallel. reflect_user extracts private preferences and lessons from the user exchange. reflect_system extracts general system lessons from sanitized tool and repair outcomes without private content. Python validates and saves user-owned memory and ownerless system lessons in app.memory. Context assembly loads shared lessons as high-priority guidance on the next request, below fixed rules and ahead of personal memory and history. One Cloud SQL PostgreSQL instance and database stores two schemas: app for users, owner-scoped conversations, reports, settings, private user memory and shared system lessons without embeddings, feedback and checkpoints; knowledge for Golden examples. Each deployment serves one company. The admin-maintained app.users row holds id, email, role and brands: managers have explicit brand strings; a CEO has an empty brands list and can access all brands. Cloud Storage events trigger a Cloud Run ingestion worker that writes Golden examples to knowledge.examples. Authenticated client feedback is stored in app.feedback in Cloud SQL with its turn and trace id; reviewers receive only owner-approved, sanitized cases for evaluation in LangSmith, with no access to raw private conversations. LangSmith holds separate versioned eval datasets and experiments. An isolated evaluation runner supplies scores to a CI release gate. Cloud Logging supplies content-free timing and count events; Cloud Monitoring charts latency, throughput and alerts. LangSmith captures sanitized step traces, and Secret Manager supplies credentials. Generation calls go through Vercel AI Gateway, which routes to Gemini and can route to other providers; embeddings call Gemini directly. After saving a turn, the assistant backend schedules conversation summarization through Cloud Tasks using only conversation and coverage IDs. An authenticated task invokes the Conversation summary handler outside LangGraph. Python checks the current private history and coverage version, calls the existing AI Gateway with permitted older turns and the previous summary, then saves the checked summary and covered-through turn atomically in app.conversations. Future actions extend the plan through approved Python handlers or LangGraph nodes. The agent sends action names and inputs to future chart, email and web search capabilities. Python validates current permissions and inputs before execution. Email requires checks and confirmation before sending.

g.text: app: users · conversations · reports · settings · memory · feedback · checkpoints
Solid: live data Dashed: background / support Dotted grey boundary: backend Dotted links: future Blue: agent
